title: Rapala Recalls StrikeMaster Ice Augers Due To Injury Hazard
summary: The trigger switch on the auger could fail and the unit not turn off, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 3,000 in the United States and 60 in Canada.

title: Children's Pajamas Recalled by KTM North America for Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 2,800.

title: Dirt Devil Recalls Hand Vac Turbo Tool Accessory Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The interior fan of the Turbo Tool accessory can break and eject from the tool housing, posing a laceration hazard to the user or bystanders. Units: About 22,000 in the United States and about 2,500 in Canada.

title: Melville Direct Recalls Aquarium Motion Lamps Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively by Bits & Pieces (Recall Alert)
summary: The lamp can overheat and spark when plugged in, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,600.

title: Dream on Me Recalls 2-in-1 Bassinet to Cradle Due to Fall and Suffocation Hazards
summary: The wire supports on the sides of the bassinet can disconnect causing the fabric sides to lower; posing a risk that infants can fall out or become entrapped and suffocate. Units: About 13,000.

title: Flow Sports Inc. Recalls Snowboard Bindings Due to Fall Hazard
summary: A pin can disengage and cause the binding to open, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 10,400.

title: Child’s Catastrophic Brain Injury Prompts Recall of Residential Elevators Sold Exclusively by Coastal Carolina Elevators Due to Crushing Hazard
summary: The elevator can operate while the gate door is open, posing a crushing hazard. Units: About 240.

title: Spinrite Recalls Bernat Tizzy Yarn Due to Entanglement Hazard
summary: In finished knit or crochet items, the yarn can unravel or snag and form a loop, posing an entanglement hazard to young children. Units: About 620,000 in the U.S and about 220,000 in Canada.

title: CreaMiser Refrigerated Creamer Dispensers Recalled by WhiteWave Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A relay inside the creamer dispensers can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,600.

title: Levels of Discovery Recalls Airplane Rocker Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The red wooden knobs on the rocker's steering panel console can detach, posing a small parts choking hazard to young children. Units: About 150.

title: Westinghouse Lighting Recalls Glass Shade Holders Due to Risk of Electrical Shock; Sold at Home Depot Stores
summary: The pull chain switch on the glass shade holder is incorrectly wired, posing a shock hazard to the consumer. Units: About 5,000.

title: Youth Loungewear Pants Recalled by M&M'S World Store Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The youth loungewear pants fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 19,000.

title: Kid's Korner Children's Zipper Hooded Sweatshirts Recalled by Kroger Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The sweatshirt zipper pull can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 140,000.

title: SCARPA North America Recalls Ski Boots with Tronic System Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The Tronic system, can unexpectedly switch from ski mode to walk mode, not allowing the boot to release from the binding, posing a fall or injury hazard. Units: About 2100 in U.S. and 250 in Canada.

title: Urban Outfitters Recalls Teacups Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The tea cups are mislabeled as microwave safe. If microwaved, the gold paint accents on the teacups can spark, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 11,640 units in the United States and 1,730 in Canada.

title: Children's Pajamas Recalled by K.J. Sportswear California Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 9,200.

title: efco Expands Recall of Gas Trimmers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The muffler on the engine can break during use and pose a fire hazard. Units: About 1,900 in the United States and 200 in Canada. This product was previously recalled in December 2013.

title: Bauer Hockey Recalls Hockey Goalie Masks and Replacement Wires Due to Facial Impact or Laceration Hazard
summary: The metal wires on the cages can break, posing a facial impact or laceration hazard. Units: About 1,200 in the U.S. and 1,300 in Canada.

title: Blinds To Go Recalls Window Shades Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The shade's chain or cord loop can slip out of the hold-down device, posing a strangulation hazard for small children. Units: About 200,000.

title: Giant Factories Recalls Water Heaters Due to Risk of Fire, Explosion
summary: On units with a space between the bottom of the water tank and the combustion chamber, the flame arrestor or flame arrestor plate can fail, posing a risk of fire or explosion if flammable liquids or gases are nearby. Units: About 240.

title: Lands' End Recalls Children's Pajamas and Robes Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The pajamas and robes fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 173,000.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Aerobars Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bolt used to affix the aerobars to the bicycle can loosen, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 8,300.

title: Linon Home Décor Products Recalls Foldable Wood Patio Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair can unexpectedly tip over when a consumer sits on the edge of the seat, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 3,300.
